tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Who Brent Burgess is: his job title, a short introduction, where he is based, his current availability for work, his skills, how to reach him, and the main pages of the site. Use it first, and for any question about contacting or hiring him.

tools.name: list_projects
tools.description: The projects on the site: what each is, whether it is running, what it changed, the tools it uses, and its case study if there is one. Filter with status, for example "running".

tools.name: list_content
tools.description: Every post, case study and page the server can read, newest first, with each one’s sections. Filter with kind ("post", "case_study" or "page"). Pass an id to fetch to read it.

tools.name: search
tools.description: Full-text search over everything published: posts, case studies, the About, Consulting, Now, Privacy and Résumé pages (his work history is on the résumé), and the projects. Use plain keywords, such as "resumable upload" or "fixed-price audit". Each result is a section; pass its id to fetch to read i

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of a post, case study, page or project as Markdown, or one section of it. The id can be an id from search or list_content (such as "work/sleep-anchor"), a path ("/about"), a brentburgess.com URL, a brentburgess:// URI or a unique slug ("consulting"). Add #anchor for one section, as sea

tools.name: get_site_stats
tools.description: The figures on this site’s data page: browser page views and font downloads since launch, crawlers and scans in the latest complete week, commits, pull requests and CI runs, and the nightly pipeline’s tests and sources, each with the last day the data covers. For the tables behind them, use query_da

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: The rows of one table behind this site’s data page, oldest first, with each column’s type and meaning. Filter by date with from and to (YYYY-MM-DD), which apply to the table’s date column; if more rows match than the limit, the most recent are returned. Daily and weekly tables keep about a year.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list_content, search, fetch, get_site_stats · Public sink: list_content, search, fetch.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list_content, search, fetch, get_site_stats · Public sink: list_content, search, fetch

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
